observation: session-registry.ts:registerAgentSession directly resolved unqualified runRoot path (resolve(options.runRoot)) creating loose directories 34-repository-root-hygiene-guard/runtime/sessions and 35-comprehensive-olt-documentation-overhaul/runtime/sessions directly on repository root instead of inside .olt/capsules/
remediation: Update session-registry.ts:registerAgentSession to qualify bare runRoot identifiers with resolveCapsulesDir(repoRoot) if options.runRoot is not already an absolute path or existing capsule directory. Clean up loose root directories.

occurrences.detail: session-registry.ts:registerAgentSession directly resolved unqualified runRoot path (resolve(options.runRoot)) creating loose directories 34-repository-root-hygiene-guard/runtime/sessions and 35-comprehensive-olt-documentation-overhaul/runtime/sessions directly on repository root instead of inside .olt/capsules/

curation.reason: Fixed by commit 50b48377320dd25752175d5d4e09c861f718ec4d and covered by the bare-run root-hygiene regression test.

resolution.test_assertion: registerSessionGrant with a bare run ID writes the runtime session under .olt/capsules/<run>/runtime/sessions and leaves both repository-root and cwd loose-run paths absent
resolution.remediation_notes: Bare run IDs are qualified through resolveCapsulesDir(repoRoot); the dedicated regression test verifies the canonical capsule path and both forbidden loose paths.

observation: Task-queue read-modify-write could lose or corrupt concurrent updates without a durable lock.
remediation: Added locked strict queue mutations with atomic rename and durable write ordering.

curation.reason: Resolved by focused round 15 regression coverage.

resolution.test_assertion: strict corrupt records, synchronized distinct enqueue, exactly-one pop lease, pre/post rename durability
resolution.remediation_notes: Queue operations now reject corruption, serialize mutations, and preserve data through rename fault boundaries.

observation: Session-grant persistence allowed nontransactional authority state under filesystem failure or link traversal.
remediation: Made grants transactional with link-safe paths, rollback, fsync ordering, and ledger compensation.

curation.reason: Resolved by focused round 15 authority regression coverage.

resolution.test_assertion: traversal/symlink/hardlink, PID rollback, fsync order, ledger compensation
resolution.remediation_notes: Authority grants are link-safe and compensate both process and ledger state on failed persistence.

observation: Completion-ledger updates could accept invalid records or lose concurrent writes during migration.
remediation: Added strict validation, locking, durability barriers, race handling, and migration locking.

curation.reason: Resolved by focused round 16 ledger regression coverage.

resolution.test_assertion: strict malformed/unknown, durability, distinct/same-ID races, migration lock
resolution.remediation_notes: Completion mutations now fail closed and remain durable across concurrent and migration paths.

observation: Meta-audit injection could bypass authority boundaries or affect the wrong repository session.
remediation: Enforced authorization checks, byte-preserving denial, one-shot append, and target-repository session isolation.

curation.reason: Resolved by focused round 16 authority regression coverage.

resolution.test_assertion: denied backlog byte preservation, authorized exactly-one append, target-repo session isolation
resolution.remediation_notes: Injection is now denied without mutation unless authorized, and authorized writes are isolated to the target repository.

observation: Quota lifecycle state lacked durable, run-bound authority handling across failures and resume races.
remediation: Bound quota snapshots to authorized executions and made staged fault recovery resumable exactly once.

curation.reason: Resolved by focused round 17 quota lifecycle regression coverage.

resolution.test_assertion: real execute RBAC, strict run-bound snapshot, fault stages, exactly-one cross-process resume
resolution.remediation_notes: Quota lifecycle transitions now require execution authority, persist run binding, and coordinate single-resume recovery.

observation: Feedback-ledger mutation could report success despite invalid, unsafe, or unpersisted injection state.
remediation: Added strict schema and link checks, durable contention-safe mutations, and PREPARED reconciliation.

curation.reason: Resolved by focused round 17 feedback-ledger regression coverage.

resolution.test_assertion: strict schema/link safety/durability, child append/prune contention, zero-count failed injection, PREPARED reconciliation once
resolution.remediation_notes: Failed injections report zero writes; durable child mutations and PREPARED recovery reconcile exactly once.

observation: Defect-ledger promotion could lose data or falsely complete a split transition under malformed input, failure, or contention.
remediation: Added strict promotion validation, durable journaling, exact-once recovery, and contention-safe prune handling.

curation.reason: Resolved by focused round 18 defect-governance regression coverage.

resolution.test_assertion: strict malformed/duplicate preservation, missing-promotion refusal, journal PREPARED/TARGET/SOURCE/COMMITTED recovery exactly once, child append/promotion contention, task-claim failure propagation, completed prune contention
resolution.remediation_notes: Promotion is fail-closed, journaled through each durable state, and reconciles source and target exactly once under races.

observation: Repository policy handling accepted invalid fields or unsafe linked state and could persist inconsistent concurrent updates.
remediation: Made policy parsing fail closed and added path, ownership, replacement-race, durability, and atomic-save protections.

curation.reason: Resolved by focused round 18 repository-policy regression coverage.

resolution.test_assertion: malformed field-path/unsupported schema, curl fail-closed, escape/link/ownership/replacement races, durability faults, concurrent complete JSON saves
resolution.remediation_notes: Policy state now rejects malformed or unsafe input and uses durable atomic saves across concurrent writers.

observation: Run execution could report automatic gate success despite invalid preflight, attachment failure, or incomplete durable completion state.
remediation: Made preflight and multi-gate evaluation fail closed, persisted attachment receipts, and enforced idempotent completion.

curation.reason: Resolved by focused round 19 run-gate regression coverage.

resolution.test_assertion: invalid preflight, multi-gate first/final, attach failure with durable receipt, exact completed idempotency
resolution.remediation_notes: Execution now records and propagates preflight, gate, and attachment outcomes before a single durable completion.

observation: Archived-objective ledger handling could fail open across legacy input, directory replacement, contention, retries, or Gate6 scan errors.
remediation: Added strict legacy discrimination, full-chain filesystem defenses, contention control, exact-once retry, and fail-closed scan handling.

curation.reason: Resolved by focused round 19 archive-authority regression coverage.

resolution.test_assertion: strict legacy discrimination, full directory chain replacement defense, child contention, post-rename retry exactly once, Gate6 scan error failure
resolution.remediation_notes: Archive mutations now reject unsafe state and recover post-rename retries once without bypassing Gate6 failures.
